direction.content_form: A distributed constellation of three substantial photographic cutout situations, with visitor information immediately adjacent to each situation.
direction.whole_expression_style: Posterized but anatomically clear cutout photography: two neighbors talking with cups, a listener beside a modest seated violin player, and a shared spring-radish salad being passed between adults. Unequal silhouette masses and overlaps construct the space without a room or photo rectangles.
direction.reference_transfer: sulki-min: image distribution and paired information can organize the whole even on a flat field; replace its portrait roster/grid and name captions with three unequal encounter groups and practical visitor choices. vi-protomen: use scale and crop to make one group reach beyond the frame, without its threatening foreground flanks.

layout.large_relationship: A broad conversational silhouette crosses the upper middle, a listening group anchors lower left, and a serving group opens lower right. Caption groups nest against their outer contours; an identity caption sits between the latter two rather than crowning the page.
layout.alignment: Short horizontal left-aligned captions against staggered silhouettes; a two-line identity follows the central opening. No equal cells, rules, roster or dominant title panel.
layout.visible_reading_route: Upper conversation and welcome → left date/hours → lower-left venue/entry beside listeners → central event identity → right admission beside serving → cup and lingering captions on the right return path. Proximity and changing silhouette scale make the next stop apparent.

direction.typography: Open rounded sans captions are the primary voice. Participation is the first readable invitation; date is a secondary numeric landmark. Title is a clear two-word identity caption, not a heavy masthead. Keep figures and labels connected without leader arrows or added labels.
direction.image: Three new anonymous adult encounters, not repeated portraits or performer headshots. Flatten color into two or three tonal steps while preserving hands, cup grip, serving contact and instrument structure. Deliberate torso crops and overlaps must remain legible; image masses shape every text opening.
direction.material: Clean digital silhouette masking with retained photographic edge detail; no paper scraps, texture filler, doll-like bodies or claimed print process.
direction.color: Light cool grey with deep olive/near-black silhouettes and concentrated orange accents. Dark captions on light openings use stronger value contrast than source red-on-black; pale text may enter only broad dark silhouettes, away from faces and hands.
direction.emotion: Direct public welcome, varied adult neighbors and ordinary participation; no theatrical combat, exclusive guest roster or musician promotion.
direction.closest_direction_contrast: Against M2, complete silhouette encounters define separate caption destinations; M2 uses a continuous montage junction and date-led editorial seams.

copy_groups.purpose: First invitation paired with the conversation group
Left numeric landmark: date and hours
Identity caption in the central opening
Admission paired with the serving group
Cup habit and shared lingering on the right return

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added copy,logos,watermark,QR or pseudo-print.
One separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster per role; not a stretched/cropped portrait,contact sheet or room mockup.
Five genuinely distinct complete image/editing/space/type systems and impressions beyond material,scene-object,palette or viewpoint substitution alone.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction, not type/whitespace-only,tiny texture/icon or glyph-model loophole.

An approachable adult neighborhood evening with seasonal food and local music coherently connected as one event. All supplied practical participation information readable at usage720. No identifiable real business or performer promotion.

Exclude the passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information template with subordinate pictures. Small pictures,thin texture,gradient,grids,font-only swaps or photographic/empty-room dressing of blank text-bearing planes do not cure the unchanged whole relation. Gothic font,negative space and coherent image-led scenes themselves are not banned. No scoped composition override.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
